item.title: CueNow 1.4.51
item.description: - Fixed CueNow's menu bar icon disappearing when ChatGPT, Cursor, Claude, or another application's menu bar setting was changed. - CueNow now uses its own clean macOS menu bar identity, so each application's visibility switch affects only that application. - Existing CueNow settings are migrated automatically while the corrupted menu bar state is left behind. Notes remain safely stored in Application Support. - Improved the update transition for existing 1.4.51 installations and fresh installs.
